title: Dave Eggers told OpenAI staff  that ChatGPT was ‘silencing an entire generation’
slides: Dave Eggers confronted OpenAI. What did he say?
He told staff ChatGPT is silencing an entire generation.
Eggers argued the tool kills nascent writing voices.
OpenAI's assistants now shape how new authors think.
Decide: will you let AI draft your first words?
thread_text:
1. The generation killer

Dave Eggers directly told OpenAI staff that ChatGPT is silencing an entire generation of writers.

2. Voices stillborn

Eggers argues the tool destroys nascent writing voices before they can develop their own style.

3. The silent editor

OpenAI's assistants now actively shape how new authors think and express themselves.

4. The hidden cost

When AI drafts first words, the writer never discovers their own starting point or voice.

5. Your choice now

Draft your next paragraph start-to-finish without AI. Can you hear your own voice?

instagram.caption:
Dave Eggers told OpenAI staff that ChatGPT is "silencing an entire generation" of writers.

He argued the tool destroys nascent writing voices before they can find their own style 🖋️. OpenAI's assistants now shape how new authors think and express themselves before they even start.

If you write, your first draft isn't yours anymore—it's the system's average suggestion.

Can you write your next paragraph from scratch, without letting AI choose the first words for you?
